errors.text_span: Abbildung 4 zeigt die Erwerbstätigenquote von Frauen mit Migrationshintergrund in Deutschland
errors.evidence: The figure and reference do not specify gender (Frauen). The title and description refer to 'Anteil der Erwerbstätigen' (employment rate) without gender specification.
The machine description omits the fact that the black line (ohne Migrationshintergrund) remains constant at around 85% from age 30 to 60, as highlighted in the reference.
The machine description does not mention that the dark blue line (zugewandert seit 2010) falls to nearly 0% at age 70, as stated in the reference.
